title: Express Checkout
description: Learn how to set up and use express checkout options like one-click checkout and quick buy buttons.
content:
Express Checkout

Express checkout options reduce friction in the buying process, allowing customers to complete purchases faster and reducing cart abandonment.

Express Checkout Options

Tijraa offers several express checkout methods:

  • One-click checkout
  • Quick buy buttons
  • Guest checkout
  • Saved payment methods
  • Social login checkout

One-Click Checkout

Enable one-click checkout for returning customers:

  • Save customer payment methods
  • Pre-fill shipping information
  • Skip checkout steps
  • Instant order placement

Quick Buy Buttons

Add quick buy buttons to product pages:

  • Buy now button
  • Skip cart
  • Direct to checkout
  • Faster purchase flow

Guest Checkout

Allow customers to checkout without creating an account:

  • Faster checkout process
  • Reduced friction
  • Optional account creation
  • Email-based order tracking

Saved Payment Methods

For logged-in customers:

  • Save credit cards securely
  • Quick payment selection
  • Multiple payment methods
  • Secure storage

Social Login Checkout

Allow checkout with social accounts:

  • Google login
  • Facebook login
  • Apple login
  • Quick account creation

Configuring Express Checkout

Step 1: Access Settings

Navigate to Settings → Checkout to configure express checkout options.

Step 2: Enable Options

Enable the express checkout options you want to offer.

Step 3: Configure Settings

Set up each option:

  • One-click checkout requirements
  • Quick buy button placement
  • Guest checkout options
  • Social login providers

Benefits

Express checkout provides:

  • Faster checkout process
  • Reduced cart abandonment
  • Better customer experience
  • Higher conversion rates
  • Mobile-friendly options

Security

Express checkout maintains security:

  • PCI-compliant payment storage
  • Encrypted payment data
  • Secure authentication
  • Fraud protection

Best Practices

  • Enable multiple express options
  • Make it clear and visible
  • Test checkout flow
  • Ensure mobile compatibility
  • Maintain security standards
  • Monitor conversion rates
